remarks: Welcome to 14 Mosher Drive, an impeccably maintained 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath ranch in the City of Tonawanda! Pride of ownership is evident throughout this thoughtfully cared for home. Step inside to a bright and spacious living room featuring beautiful hardwood floors and an open sightline into the kitchen and dining area, creating an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers an abundance of cabinetry and counter space, with all kitchen appliances included and a refrigerator just 2 years old. Three comfortable bedrooms continue the hardwood flooring, including a primary bedroom with convenient access to the half bath, which is also accessible from the hallway. The full bathroom features a shower completed in March 2026. Downstairs, the partially finished basement provides additional living space with a large recreation area, while the unfinished portion offers plenty of room for laundry and storage. Washer and dryer are included. Outside, enjoy the beautifully maintained yard with patio space, a new shed and rear vinyl fencing installed in 2025. Additional improvements include a concrete driveway completed within the last 10 years, furnace and central air manufactured in 2016 and installed in 2022, 100 amp electrical service, and roof and siding estimated at approximately 15 years old. An exceptionally cared for home offering comfortable one floor living with additional space to enjoy downstairs. Showings begin at the Open House Saturday, October 3rd at 1 PM.
